rationale: The answers are valid local preferences for the narrowed sense, but the national split is materially overstated. Malaysian Malay also accepts umum and publik for public-facing meanings, while Indonesian awam is a recognized word with overlapping general/common senses. The relation should be reframed as a preference contrast, not an unqualified different-common-word contrast. No strong false-friend contrast is present.
